desc: Ideation: reduce to min over column masks c of Σ_m freq[m]·min(popcount(m XOR c), W − popcount(m XOR c)); compute popcount distribution via polynomial Walsh–Hadamard transform vectorized in numpy.

Implement and deliver final code: input parsing (rows as strings → integer masks), freq array (int64), polynomial FWT over W bits with numpy vectorized butterflies (shift = multiply by y), dot with weight vector w[k] = min(k, W−k), output minimum.

Correctness verification: brute-force cross-check on small random cases; verify butterfly orientation and shift semantics; edge cases W=1, H=1, duplicate rows; confirm int64 sufficiency and runtime/memory within limits.
